data.name: Falgunika
data.gender_notes: Falgunika is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Falgunika is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Falguni', which refers to a red-colored goddess. The name signifies the one who is the daughter of this goddess. In Hindu mythology, Falguni is associated with love, fertility, and prosperity. The name Falgunika carries the meaning “Goddess Falguni's daughter” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Falgunika usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess falguni's daughter and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Embrace the love and prosperity bestowed by the Goddess Falguni.
data.etymology: Falgunika belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Goddess Falguni's daughter.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Falgunika total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

historical_references.reference: Falguni is a Sanskrit name of Hindu origin that has been popular in Nepal and northern India. It is derived from the word ' Falgun ' which means 'bright' or 'radiant'. Falgun is the name of the month of February in the Hindu calendar.
historical_references.time_period: Ancient India, possibly pre-1st century CE
historical_references.context: Nepalese and northern Indian Hindu culture

historical_references.reference: The name Falguni is also associated with the Hindu deity, Falgun Devi. She is the goddess of spring, love, passion and fertility. Her worship is particularly popular in the western Indian states of Gujarat and Maharashtra.
historical_references.context: Hindu religious traditions in western India

Pinterest boards feature modern Indian wedding fashion with names like 'Falgunika Bridal Collection'.
